other_conditions: Groom must be at least 21 years old.
Applicant must not have previously received benefits from Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna or any similar departmental marriage grant scheme.
Destitute women who are not financially able to perform a re‑marriage are also eligible.
If the parents are not alive or traceable, the girl herself can apply.
Marriage can be to a groom from outside Himachal Pradesh.
benefits_summary: One-time financial grant of ₹31,000 for the marriage of BPL girls/women.
